collections.name: Writing task 2
collections.description: A custom collection. The id is derived from the name when omitted.

notes.content: Air quality has deteriorated in the city centre.
In this sense the verb is intransitive: the situation deteriorates. It does not take an object.
Avoid “deteriorate the economy”. Use “worsen” or “damage” if you need an object.
In Task 2, deteriorate is more precise than get worse.

front.text: A lot of people think that...

blocks.content: Use the impersonal form in essays. Keep “a lot of people think” for speaking if it sounds natural.
